name: FreeCAD 26.3 Release Candidate 2
body:
**This is the second release candidate for FreeCAD 26.3.**

It carries the fixes made since RC1, including the blockers reported by people who tested it. Thank you to everyone who filed a report in the past week: that is exactly what the release candidates are for, and it worked.

Changes since RC1: https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/compare/26.3rc1...26.3rc2

**Testing is still wanted.** If you tested RC1, please check that what you reported is actually fixed here, and that nothing near it broke. If you have not tested yet, this is the better build to start with.

- Report anything new and not yet reported (please search first): https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/issues
- Regressions against 1.1 remain the most valuable reports. If something worked in 1.1 and does not work here, say so explicitly.
- Translators: the user interface is frozen, so the strings in Crowdin are the ones that will ship.

Still open blockers for 26.3: https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22Blocker%22

If you are a developer and want to help, pick an issue from that list or any other bug report, write a fix, and open a pull request against main, or build and test open PRs carrying the 26.3 milestone. Patches are discussed at the weekly merge meetings on Mondays: https://www.freecad.org/events.php

If you want to help review PRs, follow the order in https://github.com/orgs/FreeCAD/projects/40/views/11

📋 What is new in 26.3: https://wiki.freecad.org/Release_notes_26.3

Some defaults and behaviours changed, so it is worth reading the release notes before opening older documents with this build. Please do not use a release candidate for production work, and keep backups of anything you open with it.

🦾 If you want to help the community make data-driven decisions about FreeCAD changes, install the optional Telemetry addon from the Addon Manager.

Weekly development builds are published alongside these and appear above this release in the list as 27.1.0-dev, so make sure you are testing this tag and not a weekly.

name: FreeCAD 26.3 Release Candidate 1
body:
**This is the first release candidate for FreeCAD 26.3**, the first complete build of the work done since 1.1. We are near the finish line: what is needed now is testing, so that any remaining blocking bugs surface before the final release.

_A note on the version number: 26.3 follows 1.1. Nothing was skipped and nothing was renamed. FreeCAD has moved to three releases per year on fixed dates with calendar-based version numbers, so the next releases will be 27.1, 27.2 and 27.3._

What we need from you:

- Download the build for your operating system from the assets below and run it against your own work. Real models and real workflows find things that test suites do not.
- Report anything new and not yet reported here (please use the search): https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/issues
- Regressions against 1.1 are the most valuable reports at this stage. If something worked in 1.1 and does not work here, say so explicitly.

🛑 There are still open blockers and known critical issues for 26.3: https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22Blocker%22

The number can go up over the next weeks as more people test, and that is a good sign rather than a bad one. It means the final release will be more polished.

If you are a developer and want to help, pick an issue from that list (or any other bug report), write a fix, and open a pull request against main, or build and test open PRs with the 26.3 milestone. We discuss submitted patches at the weekly merge meetings on Mondays: https://www.freecad.org/events.php


**📋 What is new in 26.3: https://wiki.freecad.org/Release_notes_26.3**

Some defaults and behaviours changed, so it is worth reading the release notes and start with a fresh configuration. Please do not use a release candidate for production work, and keep backups of any file you open with it.

🦾 If you want to help the community to make data-driven decisions about FreeCAD changes, install the optional Telemetry addon in the Addon Manager.

Further release candidates follow roughly every two weeks, with the final release targeted for November if no blocker remains. Weekly development builds are published alongside these and will appear above this release in the list as 27.1.0-dev, so make sure you are testing this tag and not a weekly.

name: FreeCAD 1.1.4
body:
FreeCAD 1.1.4 is the last planned maintenance release in the 1.1.x series. It includes two security fixes addressing file-handling vulnerabilities that can be triggered by opening a maliciously crafted FCStd file. All previously-released versions are affected by these issues, so we strongly recommend that all users upgrade, especially anyone who opens FreeCAD files from untrusted or unknown sources.

## How to download
The assets section below is automatically populated as the builds complete: if you don't see a download for your system, please be patient, the builds can take several hours to complete. Windows and macOS builds are signed by The FreeCAD project association AISBL.

It includes several security fixes addressing code-execution and other file-handling vulnerabilities that can be triggered by opening a maliciously crafted FCStd file. Shortly after the release of 1.1.2 we discovered that a [bugfix that had been intended for inclusion](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/commit/95519fed42c46953c6fc19691542358281bb297a) in the next release had been inadvertently omitted. It is not a security bug, so if you've already installed 1.1.2 there is no urgent need to update to 1.1.3, though the bug is an annoyance (repeated warnings of a version update when saving a file) so you will likely want to upgrade sooner rather than later.
